namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Editor: *(Editor-Exclusive)* Classes that are only available when the game is run in the Unity-Editor.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Editor.Editor: *(Editor-Exclusive)* Custom inspectors for ExPresS XR Components.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Interaction: Classes for interacting with the world in XR, such as buttons, sockets and interactables.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Interaction.Feedback: Classes for player feedback, such as haptics and audio.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Interaction.ValueRangeInteract: Classes for value range interactables, such as sliders and levers.
Classes for creating composite values of value range interactables, such as a Vector2 from two sliders.
Classes for modifying values and types of value range interactables.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Localization: Classes for localization, i.e. translating the game's content.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Minigames: Classes related to ExPresS XR's minigames.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Minigames.Archery: Classes for the archery minigame (BaAM VR).
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Minigames.Archery.Arrow: Classes for the arrow system of archery minigame.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Minigames.Archery.Bow: Classes for the bow system of archery minigame.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Minigames.Archery.DojoExample: Classes for the dojo example scene of the archery minigame.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Minigames.Archery.GameLogic: Classes implementing the GameLogic of an archery game.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Minigames.Archery.ObjectPool: Classes Implementing an object pooling system for the archery system.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Minigames.Archery.TargetSpawne: Classes for the target line system of archery targets.
Classes for the target throwing system of archery targets.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Minigames.CoinScale: Classes for a minigame for weighing coins.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Minigames.CoinThrow: Classes for a minigame for throwing coins or other objects.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Minigames.Common: Classes used by across multiple minigames.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Minigames.Excavation: Classes for a minigame for excavating objects using a bruhs.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Minigames.Puzzle: Classes for a socket based puzzle minigame.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Minigames.TargetArea: Classes for a minigame that requires the player to touch an area such as breaking objects with a pickaxe.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Minigames.TileGame: Classes for a tile-based minigame for creating large areas of the same type.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Misc: Miscellaneous classes used across the project.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Misc.ColorSwitching: Classes for switching colors of objects.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Misc.Options: Classes implementing a simple game options system.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Rig: Classes regarding the player's XR rig.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Rig.HeadGazeInputDevice: Classes regarding player input with head gaze controls.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.Rig.InverseKinematics: Classes for representing the player's body via inverse kinematics.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.UI: Classes for XR focussed UI elements.
namespaceSummaries.ExPresSXR.UI.Menu: Classes for creating a start menu.
namespaceSummaries.UnityEngine.XR.Interaction.Toolkit.Attac: Added as temporary fix to allow modifying the 'InteractionAttachController'.
